_description: Permission matrix mapping participation roles to admin page access. This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — permissions.js loads this file at runtime.

portalAdmin.label: Portal Admin
portalAdmin.description: Super admin that bootstraps the portal. Same access as the committee; the portal-admin flag itself is set in the database only.

committee.label: Committee Member
committee.description: Full admin: every page and every event

judge.label: Judge
judge.description: Local admin for the events where they have the judge role: badges and the participant list
